Helping protect New Zealanders for 150 years

For generations, Public Trust has supported New Zealanders with wills, enduring powers of attorney and probate services. Start yours today and help ensure the things that matter go to the people that matter.

Create a willStart probate process

CREATE MY WILL

Decide who gets your home, assets and KiwiSaver, and who gets a say in your children’s upbringing, so you can be confident they’re taken care of.

START MY EPA

Choose someone you trust to make the important decisions about your finances, property, and welfare on your behalf.

HELP WITH PROBATE

Our experienced team provides expert support and guidance, ensuring you have everything you need to navigate your role as executor with confidence.

FIND A CUSTOMER CENTRE

Get answers to your most burning end of life and money management questions.
